setting: Human studies that decode produced, attempted or imagined speech from intracranial recordings (ECoG, micro-ECoG, sEEG, intracortical arrays, depth microwires). One population for M05, M06 and M12: the published intracranial-speech-test-partition ledger pattern (intracranial signal and speech unit named in the ledger text, 618 unique studies), restricted to studies first public before 2017-04 and hand-screened by title and method snippet; off-population: reviews, listening/perception studies, mapping studies with no decoder, non-speech BCIs, and decoders whose target is not speech content (communication partner). 2017-04 to 2018-04 is [concurrent]. Design precedents from other signals and tasks (the authors' own hand-gesture decoders) are counted as priors for novelty, as in the published reviews.

inherited.M01: Overt cued production is both training and test action.
inherited.M02: No training-only signal; labels are the cued phoneme, kept only if acoustically correct.
inherited.M03: Per-participant templates from the training trials of each leave-one-out fold; no calibration across days.
inherited.M04: Overt isolated phonemes /p/, /k/, /u/, /a:/ or rest after a visual cue.
inherited.M07: No language model or lexicon; closed set of five classes.
inherited.M11: Cued label, acoustically verified; trials aligned to audio voice onset time.
inherited.M13: Clinical epilepsy monitoring, offline; no implanted BCI.

topics.inclusion_rule: Setting above; design of interest: the classifier family: assignment of a test trial to the class-mean spatiotemporal template it correlates with best or lies nearest to (nearest centroid, matched filter, no fitted weights) versus a trained discriminative, generative or regression decoder (LDA, SVM, naive Bayes, GMM-HMM, Kalman or linear regression). Boundary: a study counts under the classifier its methods section uses for the reported decoding; template matching used only to identify a reconstructed segment after regression counts as regression.
Published rule kept; this review adds prior_tally_<slug> at the target's time with the decoder requirement kept (same population as M06 and M12).
topics.metric: Accuracy by electrode scale; subsampling to standard spacing.
